parameters.jsonBody:

  title: $json.title,

  excerpt: $json.content.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').substring(0, 200) + '...',
  category_slug: 'automated-content',
  tags: ['ai-generated', 'automated', 'n8n'].concat($json.seo_data?.secondary_keywords || []),

  featured: false,
  meta_title: $json.title,

})}}
